name: test-explorer
description: A test explorer pane, opened with /test-explorer or the Tests button above the prompt: finds .NET, pytest, Vitest, Jest, Mocha, Playwright, Go, Rust, Maven, Gradle, RSpec and Claude Code mod tests in the project, shows them as a tree of tool, project, file and test with status, duration and a pass bar, runs them, and hands a failing test to Claude to fix.
